description: This PHP file contains a test class 'EmployeeTerminationAPITest' which performs unit testing on the 'EmployeeTerminationAPI' class. The tests cover methods such as delete, getOne, create, update, and the validation rules associated with these operations. It uses mock objects to simulate dependencies and tests behaviors for various scenarios within the OrangeHRM system's employee termination API.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeTerminationAPI endpoints, including delete, getOne, create, update, and their validation rules within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.description: Loads test fixtures from a YAML file to set up initial data in the database for testing purposes.
